briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI announce massive new superclusters as AGI race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue aggressive scaling with new model releases and infrastructure builds. Competition between US and Chinese developers remains fierce amid regulatory scrutiny. Prompt injection vulnerabilities persist across deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced reasoning while Anthropic launched Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind and Meta both deployed multimodal updates this week. xAI's Grok-3 training run completed ahead of schedule.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA shipped record H200 volumes while Microsoft and Google expanded data center capacity in Texas and Arizona. TSMC reported strong AI chip demand through Q3.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory frameworks in the US and EU meaningfully constrain frontier model capabilities before 2028?
